# U157: A different number, and why: as Daniel, typing 19 over CI analytics’ 20 says “You typed 19 min. CI analytics said 20 min…”, holds “Use 19 min” until a reason is chosen (Something else needs 10 characters), then posts 19; the read-back says “19 min, typed. CI analytics said 20 min: the source is behind: I have a newer number.”, and nothing is flagged: the check-in is on plan, not flagged for its data

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `READING-RECORDED-ONLY`
- **Budget:** at most 5 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Daniel, at `/check-in/ns-ci` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U157

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Daniel (`daniel`).
- Go to `/check-in/ns-ci` in the demo.
- **Check:** “What’s the number this week?” is shown (else: the check-in’s number step did not open).
- **Check:** “From CI analytics” is shown in the reading of the number in the check-in.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `(await field.inputValue()) === '20'`, where `const field = p.getByLabel('This week’s value')`. Else it says: the field did not open filled in.
- **Step.** Type “19” into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Check:** “You typed 19 min.” is shown in the reading of the number in the check-in (else: typing another number does not say so).
- **Check:** “Why is it different?” is shown in the reading of the number in the check-in.
- **Step.** Press the “Use 19 min” button.
- **Check:** “Choose why it’s different.” is shown in the reading of the number in the check-in (else: Use went on without a reason).
- **Step.** Press the “Something else” choice in the reading of the number in the check-in.
- Press the “Use 19 min” button.
- **Check:** “at least 10 characters” is shown in the reading of the number in the check-in (else: Something else went on without words).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `held && /\/check-in\//.test(p.url())`, where `const block = p.locator('.ci-reading-block')`; `const held = await see(block, 'at least 10 characters', 'Something else went on without words').then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: a reason was not asked before posting.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “why”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “The source is behind: I have a newer number” choice in the reading of the number in the check-in.
- **Step.** Press the “Use 19 min” button.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `line === '19 min, typed. CI analytics said 20 min: the source is behind: I have a newer number.'`, where `const line = (await p.locator('.ci-reading').innerText().catch(() => '')).trim()`. Else it says: the read-back says “{line}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “posted”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `c?.value === 19 && c?.reading?.value === 20 && c.reading.why?.kind === 'behind'`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const c = s.checkIns.filter((x) => x.goalId === 'ns-ci').sort((a, b) => a.postedAt.localeCompare(b.postedAt)).at(-1)`. Else it says: the check-in recorded {c?.value} and {JSON.stringify(c?.reading)}.
- _Note:_ Recorded only: no flag, no other status for a number the owner typed over the source's (answer d).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `c?.dataFlagged === false && c?.status === 'on'`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const c = s.checkIns.filter((x) => x.goalId === 'ns-ci').sort((a, b) => a.postedAt.localeCompare(b.postedAt)).at(-1)`. Else it says: the check-in is {c?.status}, flagged {c?.dataFlagged}.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
